$comment: Single declaration of the ensemble hook set. Every hook file that exists on disk has an entry here for EACH event it registers on, including files that are deliberately not event-registered (registration: 'model-invoked' or 'none'). Most files have exactly one entry; dispatch-ledger.js has two because it registers on both SubagentStart and SubagentStop (it dispatches on hook_event_name internally). The shippable copy list dedupes by 'file' so a multi-event hook is still copied once. Three consumers are generated FROM this manifest (see docs/TRD/runtime-refresh.md §2.3 / §4.2, tasks RUNTIME-B001/B002/B003 — not implemented by this file itself): (a) the scaffold-project.sh copy list, (b) the template settings.json hook block (event order preserved via 'order'), (c) the hook enumeration table in init-project.md. Do not hand-edit the generated artifacts once B001-B003 land; edit this manifest instead. 'source' is present only when the hook file lives outside packages/core/hooks/ (cross-package hooks); its absence means the file lives at packages/core/hooks/<file>. 'shippable' marks hooks that should be symlinked into packages/full/hooks/ and copied by scaffold-project.sh into a target project's .claude/hooks/. permitter, learning.sh, and save-remote-logs.js were retired and deleted in 4.1.0 and intentionally have NO entry — do not re-add them from the stale docs/TRD/runtime-refresh.md §2.3 example, which predates the removal. 'hookType' (optional, DISC-B005, default 'command' when absent — every entry above is unchanged) selects the settings.json hook shape: 'command' emits the existing `bash -c '... .claude/hooks/<file>'` block; 'prompt' emits a `type:"prompt"` block per the schema verified live in docs/modernization/probes/U2-prompt-payload.md (`type`, `prompt`, `if`, `timeout`, `model`). A 'prompt'-type entry requires 'promptFile' (a flat basename resolved under packages/core/hooks/prompts/) — the generator reads that file's contents into the emitted 'prompt' string; the prompt text lives in its own file rather than inline in this JSON because DISC-B004 authors and iterates that text independently of this manifest, and multi-paragraph prompt text as an escaped JSON string is unreviewable in a diff. 'promptFile' is shipped alongside its hook by scaffold-project.sh (packages/core/hooks/prompts/<promptFile> -> <target>/.claude/hooks/prompts/<promptFile>) when the owning entry is 'shippable'; it is symlinked into packages/full/hooks/prompts/ by generate-hooks-artifacts.sh the same way 'file' is symlinked into packages/full/hooks/. Deliberately absent from the schema: 'continueOnBlock'. It is a documented no-op on Stop/SubagentStop (see docs/modernization/probes/U3-loop-bound.md §1 — preventContinuation is unconditionally false for these two events regardless of the setting, verified against the CLI's own source), and every hook in this manifest is registered on Stop or SubagentStop, so there is no entry it could ever affect; the loop bound for a 'prompt'-type hook is the stop_hook_active self-check documented in the same probe, expressed in the prompt text itself. No hook in this file has 'hookType':'prompt' yet — DISC-B005 built the capability and proved it against a disposable fixture entry (see the T007 hookType tests); DISC-B008 (Phase 4) is what actually converts async-discipline.js, subagent-discipline.js, and autonomy-discipline.js.

hooks.description: Static framework-leverage reminder injected on every user prompt.
Auto-formats files touched by Edit/Write/MultiEdit using project-detected formatters.

Records subagent dispatch to an append-only ledger at `.trd-state/<feature>/dispatch.jsonl` so an orchestrator can enumerate in-flight agents after compaction; also runnable as `--open` to report the still-running set.
Active state machine: advances cycle_position in `implement.json` as subagents complete.

Blocks a subagent's fire-and-forget / deferred-work claims (ScheduleWakeup is unavailable to subagents, so such claims are false by construction); capped consecutive blocks per agent_id as a loop guard (pairs with `.claude/rules/async-discipline.md`).
Records subagent completion to the dispatch ledger; runs after subagent-discipline.js, which appends a compensating 'blocked' row when it blocks a stop (a blocked subagent has not actually stopped).
Blocks fire-and-forget async claims made without real async machinery in flight (pairs with `.claude/rules/async-discipline.md`).
Blocks hedged mid-loop pause offers that violate autonomous-execution discipline (pairs with `.claude/rules/autonomy.md`).
Autonomous loop intercept/continuation, capped at 50 iterations.
Optional outbound notification (`NOTIFY_ON_STOP`) fired every time a session stops.
Auto-loads in-flight TRD/PRD state from `.trd-state/current.json` into session context.
Refreshes vendored `.claude/` components already present from a newer installed plugin (present-only, monotonic version gate); see `docs/TRD/runtime-refresh.md`.
Archives a decision-trail checkpoint to `.trd-state/<feature>/session-log.md` before context compaction.
Invoked directly by commands (not by an event) on their COMMAND COMPLETE turn to fire `NOTIFY_ON_COMPLETE` exactly once; see `.claude/rules/command-status.md` Path B.
